# getrequest

> getrequest is Scalability as a Service for your API. Setup in minutes. Scale to millions. Put getrequest in front of your API and skip building the infrastructure: queuing, automatic retries, and a full request log, ready for millions of requests. Callers change one base URL; there is nothing to host and no code to add to your backend.

Each endpoint gets one URL (`https://e.getrequest.io/{endpoint_id}`) and answers as a Sync API (transparent proxy returning your destination's exact response), an Async API (immediate `202`, background delivery with 6 attempts over ~36 minutes), or a Static API (fixed JSON). Every request is logged and can be replayed. Endpoints are managed in the dashboard; there is no public management API yet.

Every page below has a markdown version: append `.md` to its URL or send `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.getrequest.io/index.md): product overview, how it works (Relay, Retain, Recover), quickstart, comparison with alternatives
- [Features](https://www.getrequest.io/features.md): Sync/Async/Static API, request inspector, replay, bulk retry, share links, authentication, usage alerts
- [Use cases](https://www.getrequest.io/use-cases.md): scenarios by team type
- [Pricing](https://www.getrequest.io/pricing.md): Free $0 (10k req/mo), Dev $29 (100k), Pro $99 (1M, replay + bulk retry + share links), Gro $399 (5M); overage and FAQ
- [For AI agents](https://www.getrequest.io/agents.md): machine-readable overview: endpoint URL format, status codes, authentication, discovery files
